trans-unit.source: Access various system reports for monitoring and analyzing your TYPO3 installation including system status checks, database statistics, and custom reports provided by extensions.
trans-unit.target: Access various system tea reports for monitoring and analyzing your TYPO3 installation. System status vibe checks, database stats, and custom tea reports from extensions. We spill everything here, no cap!

trans-unit.source: There are no reports registered in the system and default reports have been disabled.
trans-unit.target: No tea reports registered in the system and default ones are disabled. Zero tea to spill here, fam.

trans-unit.source: Displays comprehensive statistics for records in the database including total pages, translated pages, hidden and deleted pages, page type distributions, and detailed table records with lost record detection. This report runs through the entire page tree.
trans-unit.target: Shows all the stats for database records including total pages, translated pages, ghosted and yeeted pages, page type distributions, and table records with lost record detection. This tea report goes through the entire page tree, no cap.

trans-unit.source: Shows statistics about used content elements
trans-unit.target: Shows stats about used content elements

trans-unit.source: Provides an overview of all content element types, showing how often each appears across the site. Includes summaries per type.
trans-unit.target: Gives an overview of all content element types, showing how often each one pops up across the site. Summaries per type included, bestie.

trans-unit.source: The listed content elements include both visible and hidden records.
trans-unit.target: Listed content elements include both visible and ghosted records.

trans-unit.source: Keep in mind that some elements may not appear on any page, and others might be rendered by alternative methods (TypoScript, ViewHelpers, etc.). As a result, it is not technically possible to determine actual usage.
trans-unit.target: Keep in mind some elements might not appear on any page, and others might get rendered by alternative methods (TypoScript, ViewHelpers, etc.). So it's not technically possible to determine actual usage, ngl.
